inspiration: 2.5D overworld: a software renderer draws the scene with sprite entities on top (rsc-client/src/client/game/render/SoftwareRenderer.java; rsc-client/src/client/game/scene/SpriteEntity.java). Category: a software-rendered map with sprite figures placed in it. Recreate with our own palette, lighting and sprite design.

Tabbed side column: inventory, magic, friends, stats, map and settings each have their own panel and renderer (rsc-client/src/client/game/ui/*.java, 7 files). Category: a compact tabbed panel that holds many systems. On a 375-wide phone, make it a bottom sheet with our own icons.

One short sound cue per verb, with a success and a failure pair for spells and actions (rsc-client/res/data/audio/, names only). Category: every action has a short, percussive cue, and failures sound different from successes. Recreate with our own synthesised cues.

Content lives in data files that the client loads at start (rsc-client/res/data/*.xml.gz, names only). Category: definitions for items, NPCs, objects and spells are data, not code. A good layout for our own content tables.
View reset to north listed as an original feature (docs/ideas.md line 7). Category: a one-command reset of the view heading. Keep the reset idea; the look is ours.
Loading screen before the world appears (rsc-client/src/client/loading/LoadingScreen.java, listed only). Category: a loading state that is visible while the world is built.

briefs.label: Tabbed side column
briefs.why: One column with tabs holds many systems without taking the view away from the player.
briefs.keep: a tab strip; one panel per tab; a fixed column width
briefs.change: our own tab icons and colour scheme; a bottom sheet on a 375-wide phone instead of a side column; our own tab order
briefs.ref: rsc-client/src/client/game/ui/Menu.java and InventoryMenu.java, MagicMenu.java (class and file names read)
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: yes as a bottom sheet; signature behaviour: tab switch; signature sound: one click cue; resemblance target 20-30 percent. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only (restricted donor).

briefs.label: Hill with figures
briefs.why: A software-rendered overworld with sprite figures on top keeps the scene readable on weak hardware.
briefs.keep: a sprite entity with its own position, size and layer; a simple ground layer
briefs.change: our own palette; lighting that follows the slope; figures at our own size and proportions
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: yes (a figure on a hill); signature behaviour: figure sits on the terrain; signature sound: none read. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only (restricted donor).

briefs.label: Cue per verb
briefs.why: Each action has its own short sound, so the player knows what happened without looking.
briefs.keep: a short cue per verb; a separate failure cue
briefs.change: our own synthesised cues in one instrument family; a pitch set of our own; longer tails on success
briefs.fit: silhouette: n/a; signature sound: one cue per verb with a failure pair; resemblance target 20-30 percent. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only (restricted donor).
